notes_for_editor: Only one source gives the tower's history: the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes a 30 April 1934 Florence Morning News item. The page heading says Marlboro County while the quoted item refers to the Florence County tower system; the story reports the conflict and the record's Marlboro County is left unchanged. Height converted from 100 ft (30.48 m rounded to 30.5). Statewide phase-out context is from the Post and Courier article, which is undated in our copy. No source found the tower's later history or what stands at the site now. The Forestry Commission history page on scfc.gov has no tower content. A Redfin street listing (Ballast Ridge Rd) and an NHLR Wallace entry in Alabama were not used.
